project_only_lessons: A visual checklist request can remain one derived Blueprint PDF concern when its statuses have canonical sources, an artifact receipt, and a machine-verifiable publisher; a second HTML dashboard is not required.
An artifact-specific PDF provenance receipt and an L1 work-contract receipt should remain distinct so neither falsely becomes the owner of the other's operational facts.
